hooks.command:
cat "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/memory/MEMORY.md" 2>/dev/null | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("=== IN-REPO MEMORY (.claude/memory/) — read this before responding; open the linked entry files when relevant ===

" + . + "

=== END MEMORY ===
AFTER you finish responding: summarize the durable main points of this exchange, then create or update a memory file in .claude/memory/ (frontmatter with name, description, metadata.type) and add a one-line index entry to .claude/memory/MEMORY.md. Skip only if nothing durable was learned.")}}'
